Full event chain for handled alert: video_event_detected (17:13:37, 'Video event detected: obstacle at') → alert_created (17:13:37, 'Alert created for obstacle event') → alert_handled (17:14:34, 'Alert handled by 张三: resolved'). Detail popup shows ID, event type, timestamp, entity ID, summary, and full JSON metadata (handlerName: 张三, handlingResult: resolved, handlingNote: 现场检查确认无异常，已处理完毕). Page states '留痕记录不可修改或删除，保证审计完整性'. Event type filter works: selecting '告警处置' narrows list to only the alert_handled record. No edit or delete buttons present on records.

observation.reference: agent_browser at http://127.0.0.1:5177/audit — full event chain verified, detail viewed, filter tested, read-only confirmed

coverage.acceptance: AC-01: 操作人员可创建巡逻路线并成功保存，保存后可通过列表和详情读取到已配置的路线信息。; AC-02: 巡逻过程中系统识别到视频事件后，自动生成对应告警，告警信息包含事件类型、时间、关联路线/位置。; AC-03: 告警生成后，操作人员能实时收到告警通知，并可在告警列表中查看新告警。; AC-04: 操作人员可查看告警详情并执行处置操作，处置后告警状态更新为已处置，处置记录可读回。; AC-05: 从视频事件识别到告警处置的全流程信息可在事件留痕中查询和查看，且记录不可被修改。

mandatoryAcceptance.evidence: QA-01: Route created, list and detail both show consistent name and waypoints
QA-02: Background task auto-generates video events with alerts containing event type, time, route, and location
QA-03: WebSocket real-time push confirmed; unhandled alert list shows alerts with time, event type, route/location
QA-04: Alert detail viewed, handling executed, status updated to handled, handling record read back
QA-05: Full event chain from video event to alert handling recorded and queryable; records read-only with explicit audit integrity statement
